name: GO FIGURE
description: GO FIGURE is a meta-evaluation framework designed to evaluate factuality evaluation metrics for neural text generation, particularly in summarization tasks. It proposes five necessary conditions to assess factuality metrics across three summarization tasks and analyzes ten factuality metrics to provide robust and extensible evaluation.
reputation: A well-known meta-evaluation framework in factuality evaluation research, often cited for assessing summarization factuality metrics.
notes: Focuses on meta-evaluation of factuality metrics rather than direct evaluation of generated text; covers multiple summarization tasks and includes QA metrics.
